scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings && bash scripts/check-no-unknown.sh && prettier --check . && npm run lint:cpp
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @aviotrix/types && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:core: cmake -S . -B build/core-host && cmake --build build/core-host -j && ctest --test-dir build/core-host --output-on-failure
